AGRICULTURE — TERMLY EXAM #2
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Growing Trees? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Growing Trees.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Growing Trees.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Growing Trees.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Growing Trees.

2. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Milk souring
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Paper burning to ash

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Hygiene in Rearing Animals 9 3.2 Laundry: Loose-coloured Items 8 4.0 Production ? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Hygiene in Rearing Animals 9 3.2 Laundry: Loose-coloured Items 8 4.0 Production .
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Hygiene in Rearing Animals 9 3.2 Laundry: Loose-coloured Items 8 4.0 Production .
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Hygiene in Rearing Animals 9 3.2 Laundry: Loose-coloured Items 8 4.0 Production .
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Hygiene in Rearing Animals 9 3.2 Laundry: Loose-coloured Items 8 4.0 Production .

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking Food? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking Food.

   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cooking Food.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking Food.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Preparing Animal Products? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Preparing Animal Products.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Preparing Animal Products.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Preparing Animal Products.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Preparing Animal Products.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Selected Crop Management Practises? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Selected Crop Management Practises.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Selected Crop Management Practises.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Selected Crop Management Practises.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Selected Crop Management Practises.

7. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any substance that conducts electricity
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Constructing Water Retention Structures? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Constructing Water Retention Structures.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Constructing Water Retention Structures.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Constructing Water Retention Structures.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Constructing Water Retention Structures.

9. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

10. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Only carbon dioxide
   D. Only water vapour

11. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   C. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

12. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Primary consumers only
   B. Tertiary consumers
   C. Decomposers only
   D. Producers

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Preparing Animal Products 9 2.4 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Preparing Animal Products 9 2.4 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Preparing Animal Products 9 2.4 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Preparing Animal Products 9 2.4 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Preparing Animal Products 9 2.4 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene.

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Crop Establishment Planting Site? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Crop Establishment Planting Site.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Crop Establishment Planting Site.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Crop Establishment Planting Site.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Crop Establishment Planting Site.

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conserving Food Nutrients? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Conserving Food Nutrients.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conserving Food Nutrients.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conserving Food Nutrients.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conserving Food Nutrients.

16. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water removes heat too quickly
   D. Water always increases oxygen

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
